items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Mike Kettenring will also be with us.

ctx.x: I know it will be. We were supposed to work it, but it looks like we're not going to work a bowl. Oh. Something came up.

Well, tonight our guest on the television version of Close Up will be Dr. Charles Merry, the new director of Charity Hospital. Mike Kettenring will also be with us. I hope you can all join us. Have a pleasant evening.

This is NBC in New Orleans, WDSU AM at 1280 on your dial. Stay tuned for NBC News on the hour. Next, we'll have music on the Bob Middleton Show in just five minutes from now, and a special correspondence report, 1970 from NBC from 830 until 9 o'clock tonight. All happening on WDSU. The temperature is 34 degrees. We've got clear skies in New Orleans right now. We expect a low temperature reading tonight of around 30 to 34 degrees. Delta Airlines time is 8 o'clock.
